drivers.description: Tracked AMD driver releases, newest first.

archived.description: True when this release is no longer published by AMD and was recovered from the Internet Archive. The url then points at the snapshot, not at amd.com.

id.description: Stable AMDWatch identifier. Never reused, never renumbered.

text.description: Normalized issue text: no trademark symbols, no Adrenalin channel suffix.

first.description: Driver version where this issue was first observed.

last_seen.description: Newest driver version whose notes still list this issue.

fixed_in.description: Driver version whose release notes list this under Fixed Issues. null when pending.

sources.description: Every driver version whose notes list this issue. Includes first and last_seen.

aliases.description: Earlier or alternative wordings of the same issue, kept so wording changes do not fork a record.

notes.description: Reviewer note, e.g. why a wording change was merged.

coverage_from.description: Oldest driver version covered by the archive.

coverage_to.description: Newest driver version covered by the archive.

contiguous.description: True only when every AMD release between coverage_from and coverage_to is tracked. Until then the UI must not claim an issue was dropped from the notes, because it may have been fixed in an untracked release.

contiguous_from.description: Oldest version from which coverage is known to be complete. Releases before it are best-effort Internet Archive recoveries, so an issue last seen in that range cannot be judged as 'no longer listed'. Defaults to coverage_from when the whole window is complete.

contiguity_basis.description: How contiguity was established, so the claim can be audited rather than trusted.

date_precision.description: How many release dates are exact versus derived from the version number.

last_checked.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the last upstream check.
